context: a single passage from a letter by J. D. Hooker, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: My wife presented me with a huge girl last night—said to weigh 11 lbs both are doing as well as possible. I read the Psychological book of Brodies during the operation & found a good many curious facts new to me with a redundancy of old ones. All would probably be old to you.

I send you very sincere congratulations on your affair being over, in which my wife very truly joins.— You seem to have taken it very philosophically. In my opinion these affairs, like gales of wind, get less & less endurable. Did you administer the Chloroform? When I did, I was perfectly convinced that the Chloroform was very composing to oneself as well as to the patient.
